```artifact
Decision Table for Requirement BR-1 (System Availability by PinCode)
Conditions:
- PinCode: {SpecifiedPinCodes}
Actions:
- Access: ALLOW | DENY

| PinCode                | Access |
|------------------------|--------|
| SpecifiedPinCodes      | ALLOW  |
| NonSpecifiedPinCodes   | DENY   |

Decision Table for Requirement BR-2-1 (User Login)
Conditions:
- UserID: {ValidUserID}
- Password: {ValidPassword}
Actions:
- Login: SUCCESS | FAILURE

| UserID          | Password | Login   |
|-----------------|----------|---------|
| ValidUserID     | ValidPassword | SUCCESS |
| InvalidUserID   | Any       | FAILURE |
| ValidUserID     | InvalidPassword | FAILURE |

Decision Table for Requirement BR-2-2 (Secure Password Management)
Conditions:
- PasswordManagement: {SecureMethod}
Actions:
- Manage: SECURE | INSECURE

| SecureMethod | Manage |
|--------------|--------|
| Encrypted    | SECURE |
| PlainText    | INSECURE |

Decision Table for Requirement BR-3 (Speciality and Doctors)
Conditions:
- Speciality: {SingleSpeciality}
- Doctors: {OneOrMoreDoctors}
Actions:
- Link: VALID | INVALID

| Speciality | Doctors | Link |
|------------|----------|------|
| SingleSpeciality | OneOrMoreDoctors | VALID |
| SingleSpeciality | ZeroDoctors     | INVALID |

Decision Table for Requirement BR-4 (Doctor to Speciality Mapping)
Conditions:
- Doctor: {SingleDoctor}
- Speciality: {OneSpeciality}
Actions:
- Map: VALID | INVALID

| Doctor   | Speciality | Map |
|----------|------------|-----|
| SingleDoctor | OneSpeciality | VALID |
| SingleDoctor | MultipleSpecialities | INVALID |

Decision Table for Requirement BR-5 (Doctor Consultation to Patients)
Conditions:
- Doctor: {ProvidingDoctor}
- Patients: {OneOrMorePatients}
Actions:
- Consult: ALLOW | DENY

| ProvidingDoctor | Patients | Consult |
|-----------------|----------|---------|
| ProvidingDoctor | OneOrMorePatients | ALLOW |
| ProvidingDoctor | ZeroPatients      | DENY   |

Decision Table for Requirement BR-6 (Patient Registration)
Conditions:
- Patient: {RegisteringPatient}
Actions:
- Register: SUCCESS | FAILURE

| RegisteringPatient | Register |
|--------------------|----------|
| NewPatient         | SUCCESS  |
| ExistingPatient    | FAILURE  |

Decision Table for Requirement BR-7 (Patient Consultation Requests)
Conditions:
- Patient: {RequestingPatient}
- Speciality: {LinkedSpeciality}
Actions:
- Request: VALID | INVALID

| RequestingPatient | LinkedSpeciality | Request |
|-------------------|------------------|---------|
| RequestingPatient | LinkedSpeciality | VALID   |
| RequestingPatient | UnlinkedSpeciality | INVALID |
```
